# Step - project

`project` · category: [Labels and paths](../../traversal/step_reference.md#labels-and-paths)

Turns each traverser into a map with the given keys, one by() per key in order.

## Forms

```text
project(arg1: any)
project(arg1: array)
project(arg1: any, arg2: any)
project(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).project("name", "degree").by("name").by(__.both().count()).next()   // #{"degree": 3, "name": "marko"}
```
